prompt: Page 5,000 of results takes 8 seconds because the query uses OFFSET 100000.
why: Use a cursor (WHERE id > last_id LIMIT 20); it doesn't scan skipped rows.
trap: An index doesn't fix OFFSET scanning.

prompt: Users scrolling a feed see the same item twice when new posts arrive between page loads.
tells: new posts arrive between page loads
why: Cursor pagination anchors on an item, so inserts don't shift pages.
trap: OFFSET counts shift when rows are added.

prompt: Your public API returns a next_page token instead of page numbers.
why: Opaque cursors let you change pagination internals safely.

prompt: Paging by created_at skips some rows when several share the same timestamp.
why: Use a compound cursor (created_at, id) as a tiebreaker.

prompt: A nightly job reads all 80 million rows in pages of 1,000 using OFFSET, and later pages crawl.
trap: Same fix for batch jobs as for APIs.

prompt: Users paging through notifications skip items when older ones get deleted between requests.
why: Cursor anchors don't shift when rows are removed.

prompt: A chat API must page both older and newer messages from wherever the user is.
tells: page both older and newer messages
why: Use before/after cursors on the message key.
trap: Page numbers don't fit a moving middle.

prompt: A product asks for "page 37 of 1,204" on an endless feed, which needs a slow full count each time.
why: Feeds suit next/previous cursors without totals.
trap: Exact page counts are costly at scale.
